serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: You seemed to like her. Usually you aren’t too keen on meeting new people.
Bot: W-Well, she’s on the older side so she isn’t much of a threat.
You: Come on, she would never attack you.
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: I didn’t mean it in that way. 
You: Then I’m confused…
Bot: Forget about it!
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
You: We’ve been here for a while too. It’s time to go home. 
Bot: Sure!
